mapper.select: select count(*) as total_cnt , sum( case when (fc.cont_end_dt is null or fc.cont_end_dt >= trunc(sysdate)) and nvl(fc.cont_stts_cd, 'ING') not in ('EXP', 'CNL') then 1 else 0 end ) as active_cnt , sum( case when fc.cont_end_dt is not null and fc.cont_end_dt >= trunc(sysdate) and fc.cont_end_dt < trunc(sysdate) + 31 then 1 else 0 end ) as expire_soon_cnt , sum( case when fc.cont_end_dt is not null and fc.cont_end_dt < trunc(sysdate) then 1 else 0 end ) as expired_cnt from facility_contract fc inner join partner p on fc.partner_no = p.partner_no inner join mgmt_office mo on p.apt_cmplex_no = mo.apt_cmplex_no where mo.mgmt_ofc_no = #{mgmtOfcNo}

select fc.cont_no , fc.facility_no , fc.partner_no , p.partner_nm , p.biz_ty_nm , p.pic_nm , p.pic_telno , fc.cont_nm , fc.bid_ty_cd , fc.cont_dt , fc.cont_stts_cd , fc.cont_amt , fc.pymt_dt , fc.cont_bgng_dt , fc.cont_end_dt , fc.cont_ty_cd , fc.cont_target_cd , fc.cont_cn , fc.rmrk_cn , fc.reg_dt , fc.mdf_dt , fc.file_group_no from facility_contract fc inner join partner p on fc.partner_no = p.partner_no inner join mgmt_office mo on p.apt_cmplex_no = mo.apt_cmplex_no where mo.mgmt_ofc_no = #{mgmtOfcNo} and fc.cont_no = #{contNo}

select fct.cont_no , fct.facility_no , fct.reg_dt , f.facility_nm , f.facility_ty_cd , cc.code_name as facility_ty_nm , f.loc_cn from facility_contract_target fct inner join facility f on fct.facility_no = f.facility_no left join common_code cc on f.facility_ty_cd = cc.code_no_cd where fct.cont_no = #{contNo} order by f.facility_nm
select facility_no from facility_contract_target where cont_no = #{contNo} order by facility_no

select file_group_no as "fileGroupNo" , file_save_uuid as "fileSaveUuid" , file_og_name as "fileOgName" , file_path as "filePath" , file_ext as "fileExt" , file_size as "fileSize" , mime_type as "mimeType" , google_id as "googleId" , reg_dt as "regDt" from attach_file where file_group_no = #{fileGroupNo} order by nvl(file_sort_order, 999), reg_dt

select p.partner_no as "partnerNo" , p.partner_nm as "partnerNm" , p.biz_ty_nm as "bizTyNm" , p.pic_nm as "picNm" , p.pic_telno as "picTelno" from partner p inner join mgmt_office mo on p.apt_cmplex_no = mo.apt_cmplex_no where mo.mgmt_ofc_no = #{mgmtOfcNo} and p.use_yn = 'Y' order by p.partner_nm

select f.facility_no as "facilityNo" , f.facility_nm as "facilityNm" , f.facility_ty_cd as "facilityTyCd" , cc.code_name as "facilityTyNm" , f.dong_no as "dongNo" , f.loc_cn as "locCn" , case when f.dong_no is null then '공용' when instr(f.dong_no, '_') > 0 then substr(f.dong_no, instr(f.dong_no, '_') + 1) || '동' else f.dong_no || '동' end as "dongDisplay" , case when f.dong_no is null then '공용 · ' || nvl(f.loc_cn, '상세 위치 미등록') when instr(f.dong_no, '_') > 0 then substr(f.dong_no, instr(f.dong_no, '_') + 1) || '동 · ' || nvl(f.loc_cn, '상세 위치 미등록') else f.dong_no || '동 · ' || nvl(f.loc_cn, '상세 위치 미등록') end as "facilityLocationText" from facility f inner join mgmt_office mo on f.apt_cmplex_no = mo.apt_cmplex_no left join common_code cc on f.facility_ty_cd = cc.code_no_cd where mo.mgmt_ofc_no = #{mgmtOfcNo} and f.use_yn = 'Y' order by case when f.dong_no is null then 0 else 1 end , case when f.dong_no is null then 0 when instr(f.dong_no, '_') > 0 then to_number(substr(f.dong_no, instr(f.dong_no, '_') + 1)) else 9999 end , f.facility_nm
select utility_provider_no as utility_provider_no , csv_idntf_key as csv_idntf_key , ext_cust_no as ext_cust_no , rmrk_cn as utility_rmrk_cn from utility_provider where cont_no = #{contNo}
